mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visual_screen.vs_lib_index_scheme( ID, SCHEME_DESCR, SCHEME_SQL, SCHEME_COLUMS, SCHEME_CONDITON, ADD_USERID, ADD_DATE ) SELECT ID, SCHEME_DESCR, SCHEME_SQL, SCHEME_COLUMS, SCHEME_CONDITON, #{params.userId}, NOW() FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_scheme WHERE ID = #{params.ID}
mapper.select: SELECT s.SCHEME_COLUMS FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_scheme s WHERE s.id=#{schemeId}

SELECT o.INDEX_ID, CASE WHEN o.INDEX_TYPE = '0' THEN o.INDEX_NAME ELSE CONCAT(o.INDEX_NAME,'(%)') END AS INDEX_NAME FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation o WHERE o.index_id in
#{indexId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_scheme s WHERE S.IS_DELETE='1'
AND s.ADD_USERID=#{params.userId} AND IS_PUBLIC_SCHEME = '1'
AND IS_PUBLIC_SCHEME = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM indicators_lib.lib_public_scheme s WHERE s.ADD_USERID=#{params.userId}

SELECT s.ID,s.SCHEME_DESCR,s.SCHEME_CONDITON,s.IS_PUBLIC_SCHEME,indicators_lib.f_get_IndexName(s.SCHEME_COLUMS) AS INDEX_NAME, IS_PUSH
,p.ID AS PUBLIC_ID
FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_scheme s
RIGHT JOIN indicators_lib.lib_public_scheme p ON s.ID=p.SCHEME_ID AND s.ADD_USERID=p.ADD_USERID
WHERE S.IS_DELETE='1'
AND s.ADD_USERID=#{params.userId} AND IS_PUBLIC_SCHEME = '1'
AND IS_PUBLIC_SCHEME = '0'
AND s.SCHEME_DESCR LIKE '%${params.schemeDescr}%'
ORDER BY MODIFY_DATE DESC LIMIT ${params.pageSize} OFFSET ${params.page}
SELECT s.SCHEME_SQL FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_scheme s WHERE s.id=#{schemeId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM indicators_lib.lib_public_scheme WHERE ADD_USERID = #{params.userId} AND SCHEME_ID = #{params.schemeId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO indicators_lib.lib_public_scheme VALUES ( #{params.publicId}, #{params.schemeId}, #{params.userId}, #{params.date}, null, null )
